We propose a transfer learning method for sequence data by learning to collocate the cells from the source domain to target domain.

1) the transfer learning can be enabled by RNNs, 2) the transfer learning is not feasible for the seq2seq and the sequence labeling tasks, 3) the transfer learning for RNNs can be achieved by learning to collocate, and 4) the proposed method can be easily integrated into existing RNN-based transfer learning methods.
